spans.s:
रट् r. 1st and 10th cl. (रटति रटयति)
 1. To speak.
 2. To shout aloud.
 3.
To roar. With आ, to call to.

रटत् mfn. (-टन्-टन्ती-टत्) Speaking.
 E. रट् to speak, शतृ aff.

रटन n. (-नं) Speaking, shouting.
 E. रट्, and ल्युट् aff.

रटन्ती f. (-न्ती) The fourteenth of the dark-half of Māgha when bathing
is enjoined.
 E. रट् to speak, झश् aff., the waters speak.

रटित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Spoken, said.
 n. (-तं) The roaring of flame.
 E. रट्
to speak, aff. क्त ।

राटि f. (-टिः) War, battle.
 E. रट् to speak, to sound, aff. ङीप् ।
